items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish redistribution or commercial display rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and gated. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not claim certification, revenue, ROI, or causal lift.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts are progress but do not satisfy any task deliverable. Close no task without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted storage, derivation, caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or matching. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only log, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. No build, publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each site covering execution ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.
